package.name: tier4_system_msgs
package.description: Vendored subset of tier4_system_msgs: the Autoware 1.5.0 MRM set (MrmBehaviorStatus, OperateMrm, ...) the island image uses, and the Autoware 2.0.0 (0.53.0) command mode set (CommandMode*, CommandSourceStatus, InLaneStopTrigger, SelectCommandSource) the L4 island names. Each .msg is verbatim from its release; the shared ones are identical in both.
